arxiv-2005-01136.title: Solving natural conic formulations with Hypatia.jl
arxiv-2005-01136.creator: Chris Coey, Lea Kapelevich, Juan Pablo Vielma
arxiv-2005-01136.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Chris Coey, Lea Kapelevich, Juan Pablo Vielma. Many convex optimization problems can be represented through conic extended formulations with auxiliary variables and constraints using only the small number of standard cones recognized by advanced conic solvers such as MOSEK 9. Such extended formulations are often significantly larger and more complex than equivalent conic natural formulations , which can use a much broader class of exotic cones .

arxiv-2205-11306.title: Sample Efficient Approaches for Idiomaticity Detection
arxiv-2205-11306.description: Abstract Deep neural models, in particular Transformer-based pre-trained language models, require a significant amount of data to train. This need for data tends to lead to problems when dealing with idiomatic multiword expressions (MWEs), which are inherently less frequent in natural text. As such, this work explores sample efficient methods of idiomaticity detection.

arxiv-2310-04350.title: Evidence of pair production of longitudinally polarised vector bosons and study of CP properties in Z ​ Z → 4 ​ ℓ ZZ\to 4\ell events with the ATLAS detector at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV
arxiv-2310-04350.description: Abstract A study of the polarisation and CP properties in Z ​ Z ZZ production is presented. The used data set corresponds to an integrated luminosity of 140 fb -1 of proton–proton collisions at a centre-of-mass energy of 13 13 TeV recorded by the ATLAS detector at the Large Hadron Collider.

arxiv-2401-03017.title: N 3 LO Power Corrections for 0 0 -jettiness Subtractions With Fiducial Cuts
arxiv-2401-03017.creator: Gherardo Vita
arxiv-2401-03017.description: Abstract We compute the leading logarithmic power corrections at next-to-next-to-next-to-leading order for 0 0 -jettiness subtractions for color singlet production. We discuss how to disentangle these power corrections from those arising from the presence of fiducial and isolation cuts by using Projection-to-Born improved slicing.

arxiv-2407-18297.title: Complete Gravitational-Wave Spectrum of the Sun
arxiv-2407-18297.creator: Camilo García-Cely, Andreas Ringwald
arxiv-2407-18297.description: Abstract The high-temperature plasma in the solar interior generates stochastic gravitational waves (GWs). Due to its significance as the primary source of high-frequency GWs in the solar system, we reexamine this phenomenon highlighting some physical processes, including the contribution of macroscopic hydrodynamic fluctuations.

arxiv-2408-17189.title: Tunnelling and the Casimir effect on a D D -dimensional sphere
arxiv-2408-17189.creator: Jean Alexandre, Drew Backhouse
arxiv-2408-17189.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jean Alexandre, Drew Backhouse. Two fundamental signatures of Quantum Mechanics are tunnelling and the Casimir effect. We examine the ground state energetic properties of a scalar field confined on a D D -dimensional sphere, and subjected to these two effects. We focus on D = 2 D=2 and D = 3 D=3 , with a non-minimal coupling of a massless scalar field to curvature, which provides a radius-dependent effective mass.

arxiv-2508-01914.title: Random Operator-Valued Frames in Hilbert Spaces
arxiv-2508-01914.creator: James Tian
arxiv-2508-01914.description: Abstract . This paper develops a framework for operator-valued random variables on separable Hilbert spaces. Random operators are defined as measurable maps into the space of bounded operators, with measurability understood in the strong operator sense. Under a coercivity condition on i.i.d.

arxiv-2510-19761.title: Exploring the Effect of DNN Depth on Adversarial Attacks in Network Intrusion Detection Systems Authors’ draft for soliciting feedback: October 22, 2025
arxiv-2510-19761.creator: Mohamed elShehaby, Ashraf Matrawy
arxiv-2510-19761.description: Abstract Adversarial attacks pose significant challenges to Machine Learning systems and especially Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) by subtly manipulating inputs to induce incorrect predictions. This paper investigates whether increasing the layer depth of deep neural networks affects their robustness against adversarial attacks in the Network Intrusion Detection System domain.

arxiv-2511-01220.title: Open-Source Highly Parallel Electromagnetic Simulations for Superconducting Circuits
arxiv-2511-01220.creator: David Sommers, Zach Degnan, Divita Gautam, Yi-Hsun Chen, Chun-Ching Chiu, Arkady Fedorov, Prasanna Pakkiam
arxiv-2511-01220.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by David Sommers, Zach Degnan, Divita Gautam, Yi-Hsun Chen, Chun-Ching Chiu, Arkady Fedorov, Prasanna Pakkiam. Electromagnetic simulations form an indispensable part of the design and optimization process for superconducting quantum devices. Although several commercial platforms exist, open-source alternatives optimized for high-performance computing remain limited. To address this gap, we introduce SQDMetal, a Python-based API that integrates Qiskit Metal (IBM), Gmsh, Palace (AWS), and Paraview (Kitware) into an open-source, highly parallel simulation workflow for superconducting quantum circuits.

pmc-10645467.title: Current role of artificial intelligence in head and neck cancer surgery: a systematic review of literature
pmc-10645467.creator: Antonella Loperfido, Alessandra Celebrini, Andrea Marzetti, Gianluca Bellocchi
pmc-10645467.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Aim:Artificial intelligence (AI) is a new field of science in which computers will provide decisions-supporting tools to help doctors make difficult clinical choices. Recent AI applications in otolaryngology include head and neck oncology, rhinology, neurotology, and laryngology.

pmc-10747765.title: Lipidomics Profiling of Metformin-Induced Changes in Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Insights and Biomarker Potential
pmc-10747765.creator: Muhammad Mujammami, Shereen M. Aleidi, Adriana Zardini Buzatto, Awad Alshahrani, Reem H. AlMalki, Hicham Benabdelkamel, Mohammed Al Dubayee, Liang Li, Ahmad Aljada, Anas M. Abdel Rahman
pmc-10747765.description: Metformin is the first-line oral medication for treating type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). In the current study, an untargeted lipidomic analytical approach was used to investigate the alterations in the serum lipidome of a cohort of 89 participants, including healthy lean controls and obese diabetic patients, and to examine the alterations associated with metformin administration.

pmc-11420757.title: Percutaneous auricular neuromodulation (nerve stimulation) for the treatment of pain following cholecystectomy and hernia repair: a randomized, double-masked, sham-controlled pilot study
pmc-11420757.creator: Brian M Ilfeld, Wendy B Abramson, Brenton Alexander, Jacklynn F Sztain, Engy T Said, Ryan C Broderick, Bryan J Sandler, Jay J Doucet, Laura M Adams, Baharin Abdullah, Brannon J Cha, John J Finneran
pmc-11420757.description: BackgroundPercutaneous auricular nerve stimulation (neuromodulation) involves implanting electrodes around the ear and administering an electric current. A device is currently available within the USA cleared to treat symptoms from opioid withdrawal, and multiple reports suggest a possible postoperative analgesic effect.

pmc-11427671.title: Characterization of ferroptosis-triggered pyroptotic signaling in heart failure
pmc-11427671.creator: Xukun Bi, Xiaotian Wu, Jiaqi Chen, Xiaoting Li, Yangjun Lin, Yingying Yu, Xuexian Fang, Xihao Cheng, Zhaoxian Cai, Tingting Jin, Shuxian Han, Meihui Wang, Peidong Han, Junxia Min, Guosheng Fu, Fudi Wang
pmc-11427671.description: Pressure overload–induced cardiac hypertrophy is a common cause of heart failure (HF), and emerging evidence suggests that excessive oxidized lipids have a detrimental effect on cardiomyocytes. However, the key regulator of lipid toxicity in cardiomyocytes during this pathological process remains unknown.

pmc-11508275.title: Comparative Analysis of Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization and Next-Generation Sequencing in Sperm Evaluation: Implications for Preimplantation Genetic Testing and Male Infertility
pmc-11508275.creator: Efthalia Moustakli, Antonios Gkountis, Stefanos Dafopoulos, Athanasios Zikopoulos, Sotirios Sotiriou, Athanasios Zachariou, Konstantinos Dafopoulos
pmc-11508275.description: Pre-implantation genetic testing (PGT) is a crucial process for selecting embryos created through assisted reproductive technology (ART). Couples with chromosomal rearrangements, infertility, recurrent miscarriages, advanced maternal age, known single-gene disorders, a family history of genetic conditions, previously affected pregnancies, poor embryo quality, or congenital anomalies may be candidates for PGT.

pmc-11565546.title: Arginine methylation of the p30 C/EBPα oncoprotein regulates progenitor proliferation and myeloid differentiation
pmc-11565546.creator: Linh T. Nguyen, Karin Zimmermann, Elisabeth Kowenz-Leutz, Dorothea Dörr, Anja Schütz, Jörg Schönheit, Alexander Mildner, Achim Leutz
pmc-11565546.description: SummaryThe transcription factor CCAAT enhancer binding protein alpha (C/EBPα) is a master regulator of myelopoiesis. CEBPA encodes a long (p42) and a truncated (p30) protein isoform from a single mRNA. Mutations that abnormally enhance expression of p30 are associated with acute myelogenous leukemia (AML).

pmc-11772203.title: An analysis of the current status of geriatric oral disease treatment—a dental institutions-based perspective
pmc-11772203.creator: Caili Li, Dongmei Huang, Qini Pan, Pinyue Tao, Xiao Pan, Yanfei Pan, Ruofei He, Tongting Wang, Huiqiao Huang
pmc-11772203.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate and analyze the current status of oral disease treatment among the older adult in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, while also assessing the continuing medical education (CME) needs of dental institution personnel regarding oral diseases in this population.

pmc-12743473.title: Hydrocolloid versus Liquid Dressings for Incontinence-Associated Dermatitis: A Clinical Evaluation in Critically Ill Patients
pmc-12743473.creator: Liuliu Wang, Minghui Tong, Zeyu Liu, Junying Fu, Hongmei Zhu, Junyan Guo
pmc-12743473.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to compare the clinical efficacy of liquid and hydrocolloid dressings in the management of incontinence-associated dermatitis (IAD) among critically ill patients and to evaluate their effects on skin lesion healing, symptom improvement, and complication prevention.

pmc-13230903.title: Integrating fixed and mobile coherent optical access networks for unified broadband services
pmc-13230903.creator: Qi Wu, Zixian Wei, Xiaoying Zhang, Haiqiang Wei, Jiahao Huo, Xinran Huang, Tonghui Ji, Zhaopeng Xu, Chao Lu, Alan Pak Tao Lau, Kangping Zhong
pmc-13230903.description: The integration of fixed and mobile optical access networks can enhance resource utilization, reduce network complexity, and lower deployment costs. Here, we report a field trial demonstrating the integration of hardware-efficient coherent optical transmission and high-fidelity analog waveform delivery over a single optical carrier for converged fixed-mobile networks, enabled by the proposed amplitude-phase layered modulation.

pmc-13433809.title: Strong spin-magnon coupling in a van der Waals magnet with tunable chiral symmetry
pmc-13433809.creator: David García-Pons, Jorge Pérez-Bailón, Carla Boix-Constant, Iván Gómez-Muñoz, Xavier del Arco, Samuel Mañas-Valero, Eugenio Coronado, David Zueco, María José Martínez-Pérez
pmc-13433809.description: SummaryPhotons have long been the dominant mediators of interactions in cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED), with recent advances in chiral cavities enabling directional light-matter coupling. Extending these capabilities to spin qubits, however, remains a major challenge, motivating the exploration of alternative solid-state platforms.

pmc-13536276.title: From individuals to networks: The role of variation in plant–pollinator communities' responses to global change
pmc-13536276.creator: James DeWitt Crall, Marilia Palumbo Gaiarsa

pmc-13681086.title: Presence of lower limb joint arthritis moderates the interrelationship between vision impairment and fear of falling avoidance behavior in older adults
pmc-13681086.creator: Lin-Wei Hu, Merrill R. Landers, Lung-Chang Chien, Szu-Ping Lee, Fu-Lien Wu
pmc-13681086.description: Falling is a common concern for older adults. Previous studies showed that mobility performance is significantly lower in those with age-related eye diseases or lower limb arthritis, contributing to their increased fall risk. However, it is currently unknown how the co-presence of these 2 age-related sensorimotor impairments interacts to affect fear of falling (FOF) and associated activity-avoidance behaviors.
